params.title: Why your deadline makes you quit

caption.instagram:
How to beat the afternoon slump: plan your goal around it.

Why we stop doing things we know are good for us, reason #22: the 2 PM slot. You plan your goal for after lunch, read the same page twice, decide you're lazy and stop. It's not you: alertness dips in the early afternoon, and a big lunch plus sitting still makes it deeper.

The fix:
- Hardest part of your goal before lunch
- Walk 10 minutes right after you eat
- Save easy work (emails) for 2:30

When do you actually get your goal done? Tell me below.
